superorder.definition: n. (biology) a taxonomic group ranking above an order and below a class or subclass

superordinate.definition:
v. place in a superior order or rank
s. of higher rank or status or value
superordinate.translation: 高级的, 地位高的, 上级的

superordinated.definition: v place in a superior order or rank
superordinated.translation: v. 高级的, 地位高的, 上级的( superordinate的过去式和过去分词 )

superordinates.definition:
n one of greater rank or station or quality
n a word that is more generic than a given word
v place in a superior order or rank
superordinates.translation:
n. 上级, 高级物品, [语言学]上义词, 上坐标词（superordinate的复数形式）
vt. 使升级, 使提高地位, 使成为主要（superordinate的第三人称单数形式）

superordinating.definition: v place in a superior order or rank
superordinating.translation: v. 高级的, 地位高的, 上级的( superordinate的现在分词 )

superordination.definition: n the semantic relation of being superordinate or belonging to a higher rank or class
